Context: Children Education Allowance :-

The 'classes nursery to twelfth' will include Classes I to XII, plus 2 classes prior to Class I irrespective of the nomenclature. In respect of Schools /Institu tions at nursery, primary and middle level not affiliated to any Board of Education, the reimbursement under the Scheme may be allowed for the children studying in a recognized School/Institution. Recognized School/ Institution in this regard means a Government school or any educational institution, whether in receipt of Government aid or not,
